title: My Day with Food
text:
I have breakfast at seven o'clock. I eat bread, eggs and fruit. I drink a glass of milk. I like my breakfast.

At lunch, my family eats together. We have rice, beans and chicken. My mother cooks the food. We eat it at one o'clock.

questions.text: What time does the writer have breakfast?
What does the family have for lunch?
What can we guess about lunch in the writer's family?
options: It is a time for the family to be together
It is a very short meal

questions.text: Why does the writer probably eat a good breakfast?
options: Because they want energy for the morning
Because there is no food at home
Because they do not like breakfast
Because they eat it at night

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
the people who are related to you, such as your parents and brothers or sisters
with another person or other people, not alone

paragraph_translations: Eu tomo o café da manhã às sete horas. Eu como pão, ovos e fruta. Eu bebo um copo de leite. Eu gosto do meu café da manhã.
No almoço, minha família come junta. Nós temos arroz, feijão e frango. Minha mãe cozinha a comida. Nós comemos às uma hora.
